robot_geometry: 500 area-uniform points on known gripper visual meshes, deterministic seed 42; full robot kinematics; no passive geometry sampler
main_conditioning: Current robot state and frozen future commands, contact-disabled nominal robot plan; no realized future robot states
diagnostic_conditioning: Realized future robot joints only; conditional-dynamics diagnostic, unavailable from a command plan before execution
loss: Per-point Huber in physical cm, delta 2cm, 50% uniform point-time weights plus 50% native soft movement weights; no passive object-ID weighting or rigid correction
sampling: Uniform accepted whole training episodes; identical seed/order in both arms
selection: 0.5*(validation moving_pin_ADE_m + validation pin_ADE_m) + 0.02*validation static_pin_false_motion_rate; include step0
base: Released small-DROID; frozen DINOv3; unchanged architecture and DROID normalization
test_policy: No fresh or legacy tests until both training arms finish validation selection; one final evaluation; fresh and already-viewed legacy tests separate
exclusion: Only undefined prepush query, incomplete horizon, invalid input; no hit/tipping/error filtering
physics: Unchanged original OCBench Bowling and frozen action replay; no target-state teleportation or physical postprocessing
